data.narrative:
Lightcell operates in the Climate & Energy sector at the seed stage, having raised $5M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support a reliable peer-median approach—only zero datapoints met the filtering criteria for valuation-tier proximity—making triangulation limited.

Stage-progression analysis was the sole applicable method. Using the $5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.5x seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $12M. This represents the quantitative anchor for the analysis, reflecting typical market progression expectations at this juncture in the company's development.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range incorporates reasonable bounds around the single applicable method (±15% band), acknowledging the reliance on a generalized stage multiplier rather than sector-specific peer validation. The primary uncertainty is the absence of narrow-set peer data; a richer comparable universe in early-stage climate-tech would materially strengthen conviction around this range. The founders' backgrounds and the company's technology profile remain outside the scope of this quantitative assessment.
